Confidence 2. The Marathas' 1792 region is cut to the Dharwad country (Hubballi 70 km).

Disagreement on the end of Mysore's Vijayanagara vassalage: pages conflict (Wadiyar: 'until around 1553', independence after 1565 or in 1610; Kingdom infobox 'Independent state (1565-1799)'; Kingdom body: tribute to Chandragiri stopped 'by 1612-13'). vassal_end set to 1613, confidence 2.
